cells.gaps: No framework adopted or published; the NDCF text has not been found, and no source says public bodies must follow it.
cells.note: A national workshop on 27 October 2026 met to validate the National Digital Coordination Framework for the coordination and interoperability of federal digital systems, so a framework is being written; this supersedes the August 2025 statement that there was none. Stage 3 needs it adopted and published.
